name: Natsume
source:
Natsume is a mummy and is the most mysterious person Chloe meets. He is very cold and tends to fight easily with others. He has a tendency to either sleep through class or skip it completely, preferring to spend his time in the disused 3rd Music Room playing the piano and singing. He has a cruel sense of humour but maybe there’s more to him under those bandages?

[From [url=https://zettairenai.wordpress.com/2018/02/23/ps-vita-ephemeral-fantasy-on-dark-review/]Zettai Renai[/url]]
